patch_description:
This crossover combines the high tracking accuracy and low lag of the quadratic endpoint regression approach with the multi-scale trend-consistency and persistence gating from the smoother implementations.

The enhanced filter uses a robust recency-weighted quadratic endpoint estimate, allowing curvature near genuine turning points without trailing-average lag. A recent linear slope and full-window quadratic slope are compared to distinguish coherent trend changes from noisy local fluctuations. The alpha-beta tracker uses adaptive, innovation-bounded gains, while a two-sample reversal confirmation gate suppresses isolated directional flips. Unlike a fully monotonic presentation layer, the output remains state-based so genuine dynamics are not flattened or held stale through valid turns.
